title: Bedroom Nightstand
author: 3dmonios
description:
# Summary

Inspired by a real antique piece of furniture. This model can be used for models and dollhouse bedrooms.

I made smaller prints, which were functional but lost quality.

This model does not need any type of support

bedroom dollhouse dollhousefurniture furniture nightstand

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
